recentEvents: Q3 2026 interim management statement 16 Oct 2026: adjusted NAV SEK 411/share (+4% in quarter, +17% in nine months); TSR 24% YTD vs SIXRX 11%.

Dividend yield only ~1.3%; low cash return relative to NAV growth.
Patricia Industries NAV marks are company estimates (unlisted), so NAV is partly model-based.
No leverage concern: leverage 1.8% (net debt / total assets).

valuation.method: Holding company: fair value = next-12m NAV per share x justified price/NAV. Basis reported adjusted NAV SEK 411 (30 Sep 2026). NAV CAGR FY2021-25 about 9.4% (248 to 355, verified). Long-run P/NAV mostly at a discount; current premium noted.

bear.note: Equity market fall, premium reverts to a discount. Justified multiple 0.85x on next-12m 411.00.

base.note: NAV compounds about 8-9%, price trades near NAV. Justified multiple 0.95x on next-12m 443.88.

bull.note: Strong listed holdings and Patricia Industries growth. Justified multiple 1.05x on next-12m 460.32.

valuation.whyItFits: Owner of high-quality Nordic franchises (Atlas Copco, ABB, AstraZeneca, Patricia Industries) with loan-to-value 1.8% and a long NAV-compounding record.
valuation.growthDrivers: NAV growth from listed holdings and Patricia Industries; rising dividend.
valuation.saturation: Trades at about 6% PREMIUM to NAV versus a historical discount: fully valued.
valuation.principalRisk: Paying a premium to NAV: returns depend on equity markets and the premium persisting.
